body:
**New in 1.2: UE4SS v4.0.0.** The mod now runs on the official UE4SS v4.0.0 release as well as on UE4SS `v3.0.1-1195-g1ceefac8`. Nothing else changed: the UE4SS parts this mod uses are the same in both builds, so one download serves both. Tested in game on UE4SS v4.0.0 with a script pak mod.

---

A Phantom Blade Zero update (Steam build 26367565, 2026-11-04) made the game refuse any changed game script, which broke JavaScript pak mods. **UE4SS C++ BYPASS** lets those mods load again, and also lets a mod add new scripts of its own.

**Needs:** UE4SS for Phantom Blade Zero, `v4.0.0` or `v3.0.1-1195-g1ceefac8`. The official UE4SS v4.0.0 does not include the Phantom Blade Zero configuration yet (it was added right after that release and comes with the next one), so use a UE4SS package for this game that adds it.

**Install**

1. Download `phantombladezero_cppbypass_1.2_experimental.zip`.
2. Copy its `ue4ss` folder into the game's `platform\steam\` folder, next to `PBZ.exe`. It adds `ue4ss\Mods\phantombladezero_cppbypass\`.
3. Put your JavaScript pak mods into `ProjectPBZ\Content\Paks\~mods\`.
4. Start the game. A full game restart is needed after you add, remove or replace this mod.

To check that it runs: `ue4ss\Mods\phantombladezero_cppbypass\compatibility.log` has the lines `Verified UE4SS ...` and `Both validators hooked`.

**Experimental and pinned.** It is tied to this exact game build and these two UE4SS builds. After a game patch or another UE4SS update it needs a new build, and it stays off (safe) on any other version until then. PBZModLoader has the same function and needs no UE4SS. Running both at the same time is redundant, but it causes no problems. Other script loaders may conflict.

**Build it yourself:** `python tools/build.py` with the portable MSVC toolchain (see `README.md`). The source is this repository.
